newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair confirms in talks on Cargolux.
newsitem.headline: Swissair confirms in talks on Cargolux.

text.p: Swissair-Schweizerische Luftverkehr AG confirmed it was in talks about strengthening cooperation with Cargolux of Luxembourg.

"I can confirm that discussions and negotiations are under way. Swiss Cargo and Cargolux are reviewing the possibilities to cooperate, but the talks are still going on so I cannot say more," a Swissair spokesman said.

"We are looking at how the two companies could cooperate optimally. What exactly will arise from this is the point of the talks," he said, saying it was still open whether this could lead to a takeover or taking a financial stake.
Deutsche Lufthansa Cargo, a unit of Lufthansa AG, said earlier it was in talks to sell Swissair its 24.5 percent stake in Cargolux. -- Zurich newsroom +41 1 631 7340
